name: Soulbound To You
source:
General Dahlia is sent on a suicide mission to kill all the demons of the opposing side with her measly team, but just when she's about to die, she reveals her plan to take control of the situation: the black magic spell of the Soulbind. With a Soulbind, two people's hearts, bodies, and souls are connected, and if one person dies, so does the other.  Putting the enemy's general, Xenos, under the spell with the compromise of letting her people go if he takes her hostage... How will Dahlia fare at the enemy's castle?

[From [url=https://zedie.itch.io/soulbound-to-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
达莉娅将军被派去执行一项自杀任务：率领寥寥几名部下，消灭敌方所有恶魔。可就在她即将丧命时，她亮出了扭转局势的计划——黑魔法“缚魂术”。缚魂术会将两个人的心、身体与灵魂连接起来，一人死亡，另一人也会随之死去。她对敌军将领泽诺斯施下咒语，提出条件：让部下离开，自己则成为他的人质…身在敌方城堡，达莉娅的命运将会如何？

[摘自[url=https://zedie.itch.io/soulbound-to-you]itch.io[/url]]
